What's New in DockFlow 1.71

Improvements

  • More Reliable Focus Mode – Presets linked to a macOS Focus now apply correctly every time, even after you've renamed a preset or your Mac has been asleep.
  • More Dependable Preset Creation – Creating a preset from your current Dock now captures everything accurately, and you'll get a clear heads-up if your Dock is empty or can't be read instead of silently creating a blank preset.

Bug Fixes

  • Easier-to-Click Buttons – Fixed the "Create Preset" and "Cancel" buttons so the entire button responds to your click.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
